court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Judicial Magistrate, Firozabad in Case No.248 of 2014
case_name: Smt. Sweta vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The applicant sought interim maintenance under Section 23 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, but was rejected by the trial court on the ground that she is getting Rs.4,000/- as maintenance under Section 125, Cr.P.C. and Rs.7,500/- as interim maintenance under Section 24 of Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: A statutory appeal shall lie against the order impugned.
legal_principles.held: Statutory appeal under Section 29 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 shall lie against the order impugned.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 29
keywords: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance under Section 125, Cr.P.C. and interim maintenance under Section 24 of Hindu Marriage Act does not bar the applicant's right to seek interim maintenance under Section 23 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act.
legal_principles.held: The applicant is getting Rs.4,000/- as maintenance under Section 125, Cr.P.C. and Rs.7,500/- as interim maintenance under Section 24 of Hindu Marriage Act, but the ground that the applicant is getting these amounts does not bar the applicant's right to seek interim maintenance under Section 23 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act — Section 23

outcome.final_order: The present application stands dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy available to the applicant.

keywords: Section 23 Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
Protection of Women from DV Act
